chill.design_purpose: Chill buildup per hit comes from the applying skill; crossing buildup_max freezes. At the spike's numbers a whelp freezes in three orb hits, or two with the Deep Frost mod - a felt breakpoint, not a percentage. Frozen mobs are solid: your damage builds walls. boss_buildup_multiplier is the day-one status-resistance rule so bosses cannot be permafrozen (skill-grammar.md risk list).

shatter.design_purpose: The combo maker: hitting a FROZEN enemy with a trigger skill shatters it - an execute plus a cold nova at the corpse. Novas shatter other frozen enemies in radius, so a frozen train cascades down its own line. Spike-scale execute is safe on fodder; elites and bosses need the execute flag revisited in Wave 2.

skill_mods.design_purpose: Flat +1 fork for projectile skills: the orb splits twice on first impact, lighting up more of the train per cast
50% increased chill buildup: crosses the three-hits-to-freeze breakpoint down to two, which is the whole point of increased-type mods - visible thresholds
40% increased shatter nova radius: a shattered mob reaches further down the train, making cascade chains connect across looser bunches

design_purpose: The Wave 2 grammar spike (docs/systems/skill-grammar.md): one complete sentence - Frost Orb (orb delivery + fork propagation + chill payload) into freeze into the shatter hook on the cone strike - plus three tag-targeted mods resolved with the increased-vs-more schema. In the spike the mods are toggled with F1-F3 as scaffolding; Wave 2 moves them onto gear, points and boons. Effect keys: add_* is flat, increased_* sums additively within its bucket, more_* multiplies (none used yet, but the resolver honours it from day one).
